chunks: And we have mentioned what he (peace be upon him) answered him with in what preceded from this chapter,
namely his saying: Faith stands on four supports.
ai.seo_question: What are the four pillars of faith according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates the architecture of faith (īmān) through four distinct branches (shu’ab), a structural definition that underscores the integration of belief with action in Shia theology. This reference within Nahj al-Balāgha highlights the continuity of his teachings, emphasizing that true faith is not merely internal conviction but is manifested through specific religious and ethical pillars.
